scope: Option definitions for the shared Java converter and its adapters. Integration is delivered by #76 and #77.

localization.scope: Interface only; German KDS FHIR content is independent of interface language.

values.dar: DAR token from the field catalogue

dar.tableCodes: arbitrary strings; no enumeration parsing; validate with the optional FHIR validator

contactAssignment.nextTimestampCandidate: try when previous candidate finds no matching contact
contactAssignment.genericEncounter: one case Encounter with no KDS contact-level claim when Encounter is enabled and all levels are disabled

order: source IDs and stable potential-resource order
patient repetition and whole-day time shifts
transformations.selectionAuthority: Unselected resources are never emitted; disabled transformations do not resurrect resources. Reference-only modes may reference external resources.
transformations.missingMedicationData: omit; do not invent values or DAR
transformations.identifierStability: Selection cannot renumber retained resource IDs or generated identifier counters.

additionalIdentifiers.stableRuleId: Persist a UUID when the rule is created; preserve it when editing or importing.
additionalIdentifiers.counterScope: one per rule across eligible resource types and repetitions
additionalIdentifiers.counterOrder: stable potential-resource sequence independent of output selection
additionalIdentifiers.hashEncoding: For each hashContext component in the listed order, concatenate ASCII decimal UTF-8 byte length, a colon, and the UTF-8 bytes. UUID uses canonical lowercase spelling; iteration uses its nonnegative decimal index.
additionalIdentifiers.uniqueness: system/value across distinct logical resources and iterations
additionalIdentifiers.duplicateSerialization: same logical resource in multiple formats is counted once
additionalIdentifiers.collision: stop with rule and conflicting resource identities
additionalIdentifiers.security: Deterministic hash identifiers do not guarantee secure pseudonymization.

tokens.count:0N: Minimum width N with leading zeros, for example count:08; longer values are not truncated
tokens.patientId: Effective patient ID for this repetition
tokens.hash: First 32 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 over the fixed hash context

additionalIdentifiers.invalidPattern: Reject unknown tokens, unmatched braces and malformed padding; no expression evaluation.

profileBaseline.rule: Use a profile only when the emitted resource claims it; package releases are separate from terminology years.

configuration.conflictingDuplicate: reject; do not silently apply last value
configuration.disabledSelection: retain stored value; compute effective disabled state in Java; no implicit fallback
configuration.profileNames: configuration profiles are separate from FHIR StructureDefinitions
configuration.executionSettings: parallelism and environment selection are separate from clinical options
